facts.text: Founded in 1840, Saint Mary-of-the-Woods College is the oldest Catholic college in Indiana, operating as a women's college until expanding to admit men to all programs in 2015.

sources.title: Our History | SMWC - Catholic Liberal Arts College
sources.quote: Saint Mary-of-the-Woods College, the oldest Catholic College in Indiana, expanded its mission to include men in all programs in 2015, yet continues to embrace its rich history as a women's college.
